name: TurboGS
definition: An error-guided training framework for 3DGS that accelerates optimization by dynamically focusing computation on perceptually informative pixels, addressing redundant computation in well-reconstructed regions and loss of fine details.
summary: TurboGS is an error-guided training framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that accelerates optimization by dynamically focusing computation on perceptually informative pixels using sparse sampling and tile-level structure-aware loss.
